question: What is the primary configuration of powers in this system?
premises: Here the triad of powers is primary.
It constitutes a complete abiding without mutual obstruction.
That abiding is full and of the nature of full consciousness.
inference: The primary triad of powers abides as a complete, unobstructed plenitude of consciousness.
plain_english: Here the triad of powers is primary; it constitutes a complete abiding without mutual obstruction, full and of the nature of full consciousness.
